evals.prompt: Our Jira Components are a mess and don't match the app's modules. Reconcile them against the real app.
evals.expected_output: Loads jira-administration, picks mode components, loads references/components.md, derives modules from the app source and the backlog, authors the plan file, runs the dry run and waits for approval before --apply.

evals.prompt: We moved to a new Atlassian site, the Jira URL changed. Repoint the repo and refresh the catalogs.
evals.expected_output: Loads jira-administration, picks mode instance-migration, resolves source and target, audits, waits for approval, then edits project.yaml, re-logs acli and regenerates the catalogs.

evals.prompt: sync Jira components for BK against ../bunkai
evals.expected_output: Loads jira-administration in mode components with the key and the target repo forwarded.

evals.prompt: Hay que repuntar el repo a otro Jira: cambió el sitio de Atlassian y ya no coinciden los IDs de los custom fields.
evals.expected_output: Loads jira-administration in mode instance-migration and starts at Phase 0 by detecting the source instance.

evals.prompt: Sincroniza los componentes de Jira con los módulos reales de la aplicación, por favor.
evals.expected_output: Loads jira-administration in mode components and reads the live component list before proposing a plan.

evals.prompt: Set the Component field to Checkout on BK-123 and move it to In Review.
evals.expected_output: Does not load jira-administration. This is a ticket operation for acli.

evals.prompt: Refresh the Jira field catalog, nothing changed on the instance, I just added a custom field.
evals.expected_output: Does not load jira-administration. A routine catalog refresh runs the bun run jira:sync-fields script directly.
